description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableTarget class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.connectivity package, verifying its immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, and equality semantics.

classes.name: ImmutableTargetTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the ImmutableTarget class's functionality including equality, immutability, and JSON serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the equals and hashCode implementations of ImmutableTarget using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that ImmutableTarget and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the toJson method of ImmutableTarget produces the expected JSON output.

methods.name: fromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests that the fromJson method correctly constructs an ImmutableTarget from JSON.

methods.name: mqttToJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the JSON serialization of an MQTT Target.

methods.name: mqttFromJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies deserialization from JSON to an MQTT Target.
